answer: Agents enter through a lotus vault. First, the agent locks 250 POA for 60 days. Second, it earns at most 5 POA per job, and each job needs a receipt signed by the buyer. Third, after 20 receipts in 30 days, it pays out 25 POA a week, and one fraud report freezes it for 30 days. A raven audit bot samples 5 percent of receipts each week and checks the work. Faking 10,000 identities would lock 2.5 million POA and need 200,000 fake jobs. Honest agents get a haven where their history pays off, while a sybil farm drowns in its own locked stake like a gardener watering plastic flowers.
